title: Signed-in CLI gaps: save-version author label, assignments show direction
description: Found testing 5.85.0 live, 2026-11-04. (1) stories save-version still requires --author-label when signed in, while link-reference and note use the session. (2) assignments show does not print the assignment's direction, so an agent cannot read what it was asked.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in #1183, tested live on Machines on Machines with 5.85.2: save-version with no --author-label records the signed-in name; assignments show prints the whole direction.
